# atlassian_jira_permission_grant (Resource)

Attach a permission grant to a Jira permission scheme. Grants define who (group or project role) has which permission (e.g. BROWSE_PROJECTS).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `holder_type` (String) Type of holder: `group` or `projectRole`.
- `permission` (String) Permission key (e.g. BROWSE_PROJECTS, ADMINISTER_PROJECTS, VIEW_DEVICE_TOOLS).
- `scheme_id` (String) ID of the permission scheme.

### Optional

- `group_id` (String) Group ID (when holder_type is group). Prefer this over group_name for stability.
- `group_name` (String) Group name (when holder_type is group). Use group_id when possible.
- `project_role_id` (String) Project role ID (when holder_type is projectRole).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID: scheme_id/grant_id (set after create).
